description: CURB: Climate Action for Urban Sustainability is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Climate", published or maintained by World Bank Group. CURB is a climate action planning tool developed by the World Bank in partnership with C40 Cities Climate Leadership Group, Global Covenant of Mayors, and AECOM Consulting that helps cities prioritize low-carbon investments based on cost, feasibility, and impact on energy use and greenhouse gas emissions. Coverage: the whole world. It has 1 file in ZIP. The portal files it under Climate. The portal gives 2018 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
